subject: HANDOFF: frozen visual interaction coherence proposal ready
body: R&D work unit complete for ws-interaction-rd-frozen-input-coherence-20261002. Package is ready for primary review/rebase after Gen3 Alpha1 becomes actual app/** runtime. Recommended integration: add host-local Fold7InteractionLease; allow SnapshotSurface to dynamically switch FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE while retaining FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE; activate blocking only for exact active CLOSING/FROZEN_RIGHT_PANE host; release input before visual detach; if interaction activation fails, tear down/degrade the frozen visual instead of leaving it touch-through. Opening live blur remains pass-through. Important product consequence: a stationary frozen visual cannot safely stay touch-through; if interaction while paused is desired, a later policy should consume first touch as intent to reveal/cancel frozen visual before native interaction. Package ZIP SHA256=8131d8d8d134e58f2157b4b6b6d0bccb8472a3802cff51b7fbc30e77695e05ce. No production GitHub changes were made.
